items.title: MECH-449/ARC-107 RECORDING-ONLY: emit the per-bank (pre-No-Go envelope size, converted) joint that V3-EXQ-937a computes and discards, plus a K={4,6,8} generality axis (V3-EXQ-937a successor)
items.note: RECORDING-ONLY SUCCESSOR TO V3-EXQ-937a. It changes no mechanism, poses no new hypothesis and re-fits no threshold; it exists so the statistic that actually answers the question is EMITTED rather than computed and discarded. Does NOT supersede 937 or 937a -- 937a's PASS/supports stands with its basis corrected, and 937's evidence stays active. AUTHORITY: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-937-937a-cluster_2026-08-18 (status CONFIRMED), ratified and applied by the /governance cycle of 2026-08-18, which routed '/queue-experiment V3-EXQ-937b, recording-only'. substrate_queue action = none: no substrate gap was found, so there is nothing for /implement-substrate to build. THE PROBLEM: 937a computes the per-bank (pre-No-Go envelope size, converted) joint at v3_exq_937a_mech449_envelope_inertness_point.py:536-549 and DISCARDS it, reporting only cell-median aggregates. Those aggregates are MIXING PROPORTIONS, not conversion rates. Recovering the joint over 11 floors x 3 seeds x 128 banks = 4,224 banks shows conversion is a DETERMINISTIC STEP FUNCTION of per-bank envelope size: envelope 1 -> 0/1277 (rate 0.000000), envelope 2/3/4 -> 1196/1196, 1062/1062, 689/689 (rate 1.000000), stepping exactly where gng_protect_min_eligible=1 predicts (n_can_drop = 1-1 = 0 at envelope 1; e3_selector.py:1664-1679). So manifest_conversion(floor) == 1 - P(envelope collapses to 1 | floor) to 0.000000 at ALL 11 doses: 937a's headline curve is the MEDIATOR's own distribution and carries no independent information about the outcome given the mediator. WHAT THIS RUN DOES, exactly the autopsy's four bullets. (1) Emits the joint three mutually-redundant ways: raw per-bank COLUMNS per cell (pre_nogo_envelope_size, f_eligibility_envelope_size, converted, incumbent_is_f_argmin, gate_active), the per-cell cross-tab conversion_by_envelope_size (a sufficient statistic for the joint), and pooled cross-tabs per arm and per K. (2) Re-keys EVERY criterion to that joint -- no criterion reads a cell-level rate. C4's `measured` now carries the ACTUAL per-bank rate in the protect-min stratum, not merely a verdict, which is half of why 937a's 'no inert regime reached' reading survived contact with its own data. (3) Passes started_at to write_flat_manifest, closing 937a's elapsed_seconds always-core gap (validate_recording --strict on the smoke manifest: 1 complete, 0 gaps; 937a's manifest carries elapsed_seconds: null). (4) Carries ARM_OFF's tautology limit out of the driver docstring into interpretation.dv_symmetry_declaration, per the autopsy's Learning 5 that a limit recorded in the driver but absent from the manifest is NOT recorded. CRITERIA. C1 (LOAD-BEARING, GATED) per-bank rate at envelope >= 2 minus rate at envelope == 1, ARM_CONSTITUTION, K=4 anchor, per seed, against DOSE_LIFT_FLOOR = 0.40 CARRIED UNCHANGED from 937/937a -- the autopsy found the bar was applied to the wrong statistic, not that the bar was wrong, so re-deriving it here would be the move /queue-experiment forbids. C2 monotone in envelope size (reported). C3 fail-open safety contract (gated). C4 inert regime reached, measured = the actual rate at envelope 1 (reported). C5 CONTENT SPECIFICITY: ARM_SHUFFLED's worst per-bank rate across every envelope size, promoting the autopsy's 0/4224 control from a footnote to a first-class criterion (reported). C6 K-generality (reported). THE ONE ADDITION BEYOND RE-RECORDING is a K ladder {4, 6, 8}, which the autopsy's Learning 6 names as the untested generality axis: at K=4 with integer protect_min=1 MECH-448's deliberately GRADED envelope realizes only 4 states and the MECH-449 leg's authority is BINARY, so the step shape may be an artifact of small K. K=4 is the replication anchor and the ONLY stratum the load-bearing C1 gates on, so this run's verdict is an exact per-bank re-measurement of 937a's design and the K axis is strictly additive. Measured cost on the authoring box: 128 banks in 0.38s (K=4) / 0.48s (K=8). C6 SELF-CAUGHT DESIGN ERROR, recorded because it is the same defect class one level up: C6's first draft asked whether 'the smallest envelope size whose rate reaches 0.5' is identical across K. That reads the smallest POPULATED size, so a dose-ladder sampling gap reports as a K-dependence. The first smoke returned step_location_by_k {4:2, 6:3, 8:4} -- which looks like a real K-dependence and was purely a sampling gap, because 937a's smoke floor pair [0.40, 0.10] leaves envelope 2 unsampled at K=6/8 (measured: floor 0.40 -> K=8 {8:64}; floor 0.10 -> K=8 {3:2,4:15,5:28,6:16,7:3}). C6 was re-specified against the mechanism's own prediction over TWO NAMED strata -- rate at envelope==1 <= 0.10 AND rate at envelope==2 >= 0.90, at every K (protect_min + 1 = 2 for any K) -- with the per-K stratum counts recorded so a gap is visible as a gap, and the smoke floor pair changed to [0.40, 0.20] (0.20 is the one floor that populates both strata at all three K). It is REPORTED, NOT GATED: a genuinely K-dependent step would be a FINDING, not a failure of this measurement. READINESS. P1 suppression cross-candidate range, worst cell, reachability PROVEN AT SETUP for EVERY K on the ladder (the ladder is new, so 937a's proof does not carry over). P2 per_bank_envelope_strata_populated -- C1 contrasts two PER-BANK strata, so readiness asserts both are populated at the same GRANULARITY C1 consumes; this corrects 937a's P2, which asserted a spread of CELL-MEDIAN envelope sizes, a different granularity from the per-bank strata its C1 actually read. Satisfiability checked on paper before running (autopsy's 4,224-bank table: 1277 / 2947 vs a floor of 200) and confirmed empirically per K (pooled envelope-1/envelope-2 counts at 64 banks x seed 42 over the full ladder: K=4 226/202, K=6 109/106, K=8 56/40). P3 from_dims plumbing, guarding the silent-kwarg-swallow mode. 926a's per-cell 'envelope >= 2' gate deliberately NOT carried over -- the envelope-1 stratum is now the load-bearing HALF of C1's contrast, so that gate would fail on exactly the banks this run exists to measure and vacate the run (the V3-EXQ-785 defect). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = the per-bank (envelope size, converted) joint. reanalysis_query.py --readout conversion_by_envelope_size --claim MECH-449 returns 6 manifests across 6 substrate_hashes and 0 carry it (v3_exq_937, v3_exq_937a, v3_exq_699, v3_exq_699b x2, v3_exq_689g); 937/937a record only cell medians and conversion counts. NOT recoverable by reanalysis -> run. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP (Step 2.5c): SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION is open, severity=degrading, on ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py, which this driver executes -- so the run happens under that known limitation (its two untrained scorer heads are gated out of the E3 score by default, which does not bear on the eligibility-envelope or No-Go arithmetic measured here). The only open CORRUPTING entry touching anything this driver imports is mode-governance-engagement via ree_core/utils/config.py; its executed footprint is salience_coordinator.py / agent.py / regime_occupancy_gate.py, none of which this driver constructs or steps (it builds no agent and no salience coordinator), and config.py appears only as the declaration site of a knob this run never sets. Judged a declaration-site overlap, not an execution overlap; recorded so the judgement is auditable rather than silent. CAVEATS CARRIED FROM THE AUTOPSY AND NOT SOLVED HERE. (1) Selection-face synthetic probe, no training and no agent loop (reuse_ineligible_reasons: selection_face_synthetic_no_training): confirms the constitution's ARITHMETIC, not behavioural competence. PURPOSE=diagnostic, so it is excluded from confidence/conflict scoring and PROMOTES NOTHING. (2) K generality is what C6 addresses. (3) conversion == 1 at envelope >= 2 is partly a CONSTRUCTION property -- the incumbent is both the F-argmin and the sole suppression target -- recorded per bank via the incumbent_is_f_argmin column rather than asserted away; breaking that coupling is a different experiment. WITHDRAWN PREMISE, do not resurrect: chip-20260818-mech449-envelope4-nonmonotonic (a supposed conversion drop at envelope 4, and a supposedly non-inert axis at envelope 1) was withdrawn by the same governance cycle -- both readings are binning artifacts of the aggregation this run replaces. RE-DERIVE BRAKE NOT FIRED: MECH-449 = 0, ARC-107 = 0 against a threshold of 2, recomputed at queue time and matching the autopsy's own count. MECH-439 DELIBERATELY NOT TAGGED (brake 12, ceiling_decision exhausted; no F-dominance lever here). MECH-260 not tagged for 926a's reason (behavioural falsifier, vacuous at the MECH-457 competence floor). SMOKE PASS on the Mac (floors 0.40/0.20, 3 K, 2 seeds, 16 banks): outcome=PASS, label=conversion_is_a_deterministic_step_in_per_bank_envelope_size, per-bank rate at envelope 1 = 0.000000 (n=37) and at envelope >= 2 = 1.000000 (n=27), per-seed lift 1.0/1.0 against the unchanged 0.40 bar, step at envelope 2 True at all three K, ARM_SHUFFLED worst per-bank rate 0.000000 across all 6 realized envelope sizes (192 banks), empty_eligible=0, and the reconstructed pre-No-Go size agrees with MECH-448's directly-reported f_eligibility_envelope_size on 24/24 cells at rate 1.0. validate_experiments.py --strict OK with 0 warnings of every class; validate_recording.py --strict: 1 complete, 0 always-core gaps. INFRASTRUCTURE DEFECT FOUND BY THIS SMOKE, chipped separately, NOT fixed here: experiment_protocol._relocate_dry_run_manifest computes dest = <tempdir>/ree_dry_run_manifests/<name> and runs `if dest.exists(): dest.unlink()` before shutil.move(src, dest), so a driver that writes its dry-run manifest directly into that directory has it DELETED (src == dest; the move then fails on the missing source and is swallowed by the helper's best-effort except). V3-EXQ-937a has the same shape and the same silent loss. Worked around locally by writing the smoke manifest one level down (<tempdir>/ree_dry_run_manifests/<experiment_type>/), which keeps 937a's stronger guarantee that a smoke manifest never lands under evidence/experiments/ while letting the helper's move do what it intends. experiment_protocol.py is on every driver's emit path, so it is not patched from a queue-experiment run.
